sources.title: Miesto želdinimo ir želdinių priežiūros standartas
sources.note: Vilnius, 2024. Tables 1.1 (trees, pp. 7-15), 1.2 (shrubs, pp. 16-19) and 1.3 (perennials and subshrubs, pp. 21-34), with the legend on pp. 6 and 20. Transcribed as printed, including the standard's spelling. The tree table gives no light or water classes; shrubs and perennials do. An official municipal document, not subject to copyright (the project owner's determination, 2026-11-26), so it ships in full.
